## Checklist
- [ ] Title follows `type(scope): summary`
- [ ] One purpose, about 400 changed lines or fewer
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or large binaries
- [ ] Migration reviewed and safe to run with the old code live (if any)
- [ ] Docs or CHANGELOG updated (if needed)
- [ ] Client approval linked (Services, staging to main only)
